lines.t: Whispers in my head, screens keep flashing red
Scrolling through the noise, lost in what's unsaid
Eyes glued to the glowing light, comparing every night
Perfect life's parade, but what's real falls out of sight
Pressure's on to be the best, can't afford to rest
In this race with no clear end, my heartbeat's like a test
Feel the judgment, fear to fail
The silence out inside the veil
Caught in a wave of digital lines
Anxiety's wrapped in perfect designs
But I'll rise, break free, find my own way
In this noisy world, I'll learn to stay
Every life, a fleeting high
Dopamine runs dry, seeking validation
In the echo, wondering why
Fomal's grip, the constant chase
Feels like illusion raised
Craft a massive void in us, trapped inside this space
Fear to judgment, fear to fail
A silent shout inside the veil
Caught in a web of digital lines
Anxiety trapped in perfect designs
But I'll rise, break free, find my own way
In this noisy world, I'll learn to stay
Beneath the surface, calm my shoulders
Storm of thoughts won't let me go
But through the silence I will fight
Find peace within the fading night
When the wall calls out my name
And shadows cover flame
The Lord reaches down to sand a hill
And make me whole again
In his love to fear his sins
I'll call my soul to pens
He fills the cracks without a spread
And lifts the weight inside my head
Caught in his arms, I'm safe and sound
From anxious webs, I'm breaking ground
He is my light, my guide, my stay
In his refuge, I'll always stay
Whispers fade, the screen goes dim
A quiet breath, my life within
Thank you.
Thanks for watching!
